title: C3, C4, and CAM Photosynthesis Comparison
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AP Biology
description: Interactive MicroSim comparing C3, C4, and CAM photosynthetic strategies with leaf cross-section diagrams and climate suitability analysis

learningObjectives: Compare the C3, C4, and CAM photosynthetic strategies
Identify spatial vs temporal CO2 concentration mechanisms
Predict which strategy is favored under different climate conditions

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Interactive comparison with climate parameter exploration
keyQuestions: Why do C4 plants outperform C3 plants in hot environments?
How does CAM photosynthesis conserve water?
What is the tradeoff each strategy makes?
commonMisconceptions: C4 and CAM plants skip the Calvin cycle (they all use it)
CAM plants don't photosynthesize during the day (they do, with stomata closed)
C3 is inferior to C4 (C3 is more efficient in cool, moist conditions)
assessmentOpportunities: Predict which strategy wins in a given climate scenario
Explain the structural basis of C4 CO2 concentration
